original: トムはフランス語を教えるのがお上手です。

en.text: Tom is good at teaching French.

original: フランス語を上手に話す女の子を知っている。

en.text: I know a girl who speaks French very well.

original: トムはマリアと同じくらい上手にフランス語を話す。

en.text: Tom speaks French as well as Mary.

original: それに関しては私より彼女の方が上手だ。

en.text: She's better at it than I am.

original: 歌が上手か下手なんて誰が決めるの？

en.text: How can someone know if they're a good singer or not?

original: 英語を話すのとほぼ同じくらい上手くフランス語も話せます。

en.text: I speak French almost as well as I speak English.

original: 彼らは商売上手だね。

en.text: They are shrewd in trade.

original: お父さんとお母さんだと、どっちの運転が上手なの？

en.text: Who drives better, your father or your mother?

original: とても上手にフランス語を話すわね。

en.text: You speak French really well.
You speak French very well.

original: 彼は時間の使い方が上手です。

en.text: He makes good use of his time.

original: フランス語は上手く話せません。

en.text: I can't speak French well.

original: フランス語なら上手に話せるよ。

en.text: I can speak French well.

original: フランス語が上手く話せないのよ。

en.text: I can't speak French very well.

original: 世渡り上手ね。

en.text: You seem to breeze through everything in life.

original: 先生より説明が上手だね。

en.text: You're better at explaining than my teacher.

original: 父は釣りが上手です。

en.text: My father is good at fishing.

original: お父さん、釣りが上手なんだ。

en.text: My father is good at fishing.

original: 僕のフランス語って、上手だと思う？

en.text: Do you think my French is good?

original: 家の言葉が友達の言葉と違う場合、大抵子供は友達の言葉を上手に話せるようになるんです。

en.text: When children speak a different language at home than with their friends, they usually become more proficient at the language they speak with friends.

original: 初めて会った時より、フランス語上手になったよね。

en.text: Your French has improved a lot since we first met.

original: 英語、私より上手ね。

en.text: Your English is better than mine.
